$schema: Test prompts for measuring whether the mbb-deck skill triggers correctly. Run these through the skill_creator eval harness or a similar tool.

should_trigger.prompt: Build me an MBB-style deck recommending whether we should expand to Germany.
I need a McKinsey-style presentation on our 2026 growth strategy for the board.
should_trigger.rationale: Names a specific firm style and a board audience

should_trigger.prompt: Can you put together a strategy deck for our exec team on whether to acquire CompetitorX?
should_trigger.rationale: 'Strategy deck' for an exec audience signals consulting style

should_trigger.prompt: I have a board meeting next Tuesday and need slides recommending how to respond to the competitive threat. Make it executive-grade.
should_trigger.rationale: Board meeting + recommendation + executive-grade are strong signals

should_trigger.prompt: Build a consulting-style presentation analyzing why our growth has slowed and what to do about it.
Help me draft a deck using the pyramid principle to recommend our Q4 budget reallocation.
should_trigger.rationale: Names the Minto Pyramid Principle directly

should_trigger.prompt: I need slides with action titles and an executive summary upfront, recommending a path forward on the platform migration.
should_trigger.rationale: Names key MBB conventions (action titles, exec summary, path forward)

should_trigger.prompt: Put together a Bain-style or BCG-style presentation on our pricing strategy.
Build an executive briefing deck for the CEO on our expansion options. It needs to be MECE.
should_trigger.rationale: Executive briefing + MECE is consulting vocabulary

should_trigger.prompt: I want a deck that reads like a consulting report — clear recommendation, supporting findings, MECE breakdown.
Make me a board deck that lays out three strategic options and recommends one.
should_trigger.rationale: Board deck with comparison + recommendation = MBB pattern

should_trigger.prompt: I need to present to the board on whether we should sell the SMB business. Help me build the slides — they should be polished and structured like a strategy consultant would do it.
Build a strategy presentation. Each slide title should state the takeaway, not the topic.
I have raw findings on our customer segmentation. Help me structure them into a deck with a clear governing thought and ladder up the supporting evidence.
should_trigger.rationale: Governing thought + ladder up = pyramid principle vocabulary

should_trigger.prompt: Build a 12-slide deck recommending our market entry strategy. Cover situation, complication, options, recommendation, and implementation.
should_trigger.rationale: SCQA structure + standard MBB deck shape

should_not_trigger.prompt: Make me a slideshow of my vacation photos.
Build a kids' birthday party slideshow with cute graphics.
Help me prepare lecture slides for my biology class.
Create a Pokémon-themed PowerPoint for my niece.
Write a Python script that generates random charts.

should_not_trigger.rationale: Definitional question, not a deck request — even though McKinsey is named

should_not_trigger.prompt: Convert this PDF into an editable Word document.
Help me write a wedding toast.
I'm building a slide deck for my band's concert tour. Make it look cool and edgy.
Summarize this meeting transcript into bullet points.
Make a quick training deck for new hires on how our internal Jira works.
should_not_trigger.rationale: Tutorial / how-to, not strategy. Borderline — but the audience and content are operational, not executive.

should_not_trigger.prompt: Help me design a poster for the office holiday party.

notes: Trigger rate target: at least 85% of should_trigger prompts should activate the skill.
False-positive rate target: at most 10% of should_not_trigger prompts should activate it.
If trigger rate is too low, make the SKILL.md description more specific about the linguistic cues (board, executive, recommendation, strategy, consulting).
If false-positive rate is too high, add explicit counter-examples to the description ('Do not trigger for casual/creative presentations, lecture slides, photo decks').
Borderline case 'no-trigger-11' (training deck) is debatable — adjust based on what behavior you want.
